title: Choose a missing-value fallback
summary: T-SQL: Choose a missing-value fallback. Give @name the value Asha.
introduction: COALESCE returns the first input that is not NULL. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Choose a missing-value fallback with T-SQL

blocks.text: Connect to a practice SQL Server database with SSMS or sqlcmd. Run one example at a time. Results below show cell values or PRINT text without grid headers.

blocks.title: Choose a missing-value fallback
blocks.code:
DECLARE @name varchar(20) = NULL;
SELECT COALESCE(@name, 'Guest') AS name;

blocks.text: The first value is NULL, so COALESCE picks Guest.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use IS NULL for a null test, not = NULL.
